title: 第二十三章    麻烦上门
content_zh:
其实陈木这个人很少笑的，穿越之前身为渡劫期的高手，就连正常的感情波动都不会有，更别提笑什么的了，但来到这里见到的第一个女生就是刘月，更何况还很好心的护着他，令陈木一直在修真界摸爬滚打所炼成的冰山表情也有了一丝丝的松动。

    之前的世界尔虞我诈，虽然来到这里之后什么事儿也都没碰到过，但是这种感觉还不错，姑且就享受享受这种感觉。

    刘月听到这个消息之后有些茫然，“你这是真的不打算回陈家了？那个什么谢少是不会少找你麻烦的，你现在没有陈家依靠，还给苏林依做保镖，要是这大小姐出了什么事儿的话，第一个遭殃的不就是你吗？太危险了！”

    说到这里刘月有些激动，上前就抓住了陈木的手，然而陈木多年来养成的习惯并不是轻易就能够改变的，一下子就躲开了，眼睁睁看着刘月扑了个空，但是因为惯性的原因，刘月在扑空之后直直的往地上摔去，看样子马上就要趴下了，结果预想中的疼痛并没有传来。

    说时迟那时快，陈木本来躲得还算是远了点，但是就在这千钧一发之际，陈木一个箭步冲上前去，直接大手一捞，差点摔倒的刘月就已经被陈木接在了怀里。

    一下子场面似乎定格了。

    “陈木……那个，谢谢你。”刘月维持着被陈木抱在怀里的姿势，小脸微红，虽然她平时大大咧咧的，但毕竟也是个女孩子，有些不好意思的对陈木说道。

    陈木并没有立刻放开刘月，只觉得这姑娘抱起来还算是挺舒服的，当个人形抱枕或许还不错。

    “没事，方才是我反应过激了。”陈木脑子里想法转完了，这才放开刘月，但是好巧不巧的两个人刚刚的互动恰好被余北看见了，余北这人大大咧咧的有时候还爱大嗓门，老远看到两个人刚刚抱在一起的画面之后直接就跟打了鸡血一样。

    “我类个去，兄弟你行啊，刘月大美女都被你搞定了？”余北冲过来对陈木挤眉弄眼的。

    虽然余北这话明显是给陈木听的，但是刘月就站在旁边怎么可能听不到，当即就有些脸红的不知所措，但是余北并没有意识到有什么不对反而还变本加厉起来。

    “你们两个什么时候发喜糖啊，我还等着喝呢，现在陈木可是我老大，自从那次把那个什么什么黄毛之类的二流子给收拾了一顿之后，就风光无限啊。”余北本想着在刘月面前给陈木多刷刷好感度，结果怎么弄怎么有一种越描越黑的感觉。

    “余北，我和陈木真没什么，刚刚只是我要摔倒了陈木扶了我一下而已。”刘月见陈木一脸冷冰冰的没什么反应，似乎对余北这个样子已经见怪不怪了，但是自己还是要解释一下的吧？毕竟自己是个女孩子家，这么直接承认什么的会不会被人认为有些不要脸?

    不过在听到陈木之前收拾那些人的时候，刘月的表情有些微妙，事实上，自从陈木醒了之后就有些不太一样了，扔了最看重的陈家的那块石头，现在又一直都是冷冰冰的样子，好像什么都不放在眼里似的，而且听余北话里的意思，陈木现在还很能打，很厉害，这到底是发生了什么？
content_en:
In fact, Chen Mu rarely smiled. As a master in the Tribulation Stage before time travel, he didn't even have normal emotional fluctuations, let alone smile. But the first girl he saw when he came here was Liu Yue, not to mention she was kind enough to protect him, which made Chen Mu's iceberg expression that he had cultivated through all the hard work in the world of cultivation become slightly looser.

The world before was full of intrigues, and although I haven't encountered anything since I came here, it feels pretty good, so I'll just enjoy it for the time being.

Liu Yue was a little confused after hearing the news, "Are you really not planning to return to the Chen family? That Mr. Xie will never give you less trouble. Now you don't have the Chen family to rely on, and you are still working as a bodyguard for Su Linyi. If something happens to this young lady, won't you be the first to suffer? It's too dangerous!"

Speaking of this, Liu Yue got a little excited and stepped forward to grab Chen Mu's hand. However, Chen Mu's habits developed over the years are not easy to change. He immediately dodged and watched as Liu Yue jumped into the air. However, due to inertia, Liu Yue fell straight to the ground after jumping into the air. It looked like he was about to fall down, but the expected pain did not come.

It was too late, but it was too soon. Chen Mu originally hid far away, but at this critical moment, Chen Mu rushed forward and fished it out with his big hand. Liu Yue, who almost fell, was already caught in Chen Mu's arms.

Suddenly the scene seemed to freeze.

"Chen Mu... um, thank you." Liu Yue maintained her position in Chen Mu's arms, her face slightly red. Although she was usually carefree, she was still a girl after all, so she said to Chen Mu with some embarrassment.

Chen Mu did not let go of Liu Yue immediately. He only felt that the girl was quite comfortable to hold. It might be good to use it as a human-shaped pillow.

"It's okay, I just overreacted." Chen Mu finished his thoughts and let Liu Yue go. But by chance, the interaction between the two people just happened to be seen by Yu Bei. Yu Bei was a carefree person and sometimes liked to speak loudly. When he saw the scene of the two people hugging each other from afar, it was as if he had been injected with blood.

"I'll go with you, brother, you can do it, you've got Liu Yue, the beautiful lady, by you?" Yu Bei rushed over and winked at Chen Mu.

Although Yu Bei's words were obviously intended for Chen Mu, how could Liu Yue not hear it when she was standing nearby? She immediately blushed and felt at a loss, but Yu Bei didn't realize anything was wrong and instead got worse.

"When are you two giving out wedding candies? I'm still waiting to drink them. Now Chen Mu is my boss. Ever since he dealt with that yellow-haired second-rate guy, he has become more prosperous." Yu Bei originally wanted to give Chen Mu more favorability in front of Liu Yue, but in the end, he felt like he was getting darker and darker.

"Yu Bei, Chen Muzhen and I have nothing to do with each other. I was just about to fall and Chen Mu helped me." Liu Yue saw Chen Mu's cold face and showed no reaction. She seemed to be used to Yu Bei's behavior, but she still had to explain it, right?After all, I am a girl. Would it be considered shameless to admit something so directly?

But when she heard that Chen Mu had dealt with those people before, Liu Yue's expression was a little subtle. In fact, Chen Mu had been a little different since he woke up. He threw the stone that belonged to the Chen family that he valued most, and now he has always looked cold and cold, as if he didn't take anything seriously. And from Yu Bei's words, Chen Mu is still very good at fighting and very powerful. What on earth happened?
